name: Bodyweight squat
definition: Stand with both feet planted and no external implement. Bend the hips and knees to lower, then stand back up.

catalogue_anchor.notes: Original broad muscle labels retained separately; not silently promoted to accepted anatomy.

value.start: Stand with both feet planted and no external implement.
value.movement: Bend the hips and knees to lower, then stand back up.
value.finish: Finish standing with the same foot placement.
value.range_of_motion: Use a repeatable self-selected depth; record any box or depth landmark separately.
